description: A bearded man in a light robe and tan turban sits under a large, gnarled banyan-like tree with hanging aerial roots, one hand raised in speech. Beside him, a younger man in a turban sits on a rock playing a long-necked lute (rabab). Soft golden light breaks through the leaves, and a dim open landscape fades into a dusky sky. The style is a dark, warm oil painting, with no visible text, frame or border.
